about_the_game:
FAR FRESNEL – What lies beneath?

FAR FRESNEL is first-person exploration game where you descend into the abyss of a distant planet aboard an ancient elevator system.

As you venture deeper into this forsaken world, you'll learn to control your environment, solve puzzles, and uncover the meaning behind CHIONE expeditions. With each level, the danger increases, and your only hope is to keep descending.

Will you survive long enough to reveal the secrets buried deep below the surface?

FAR FRESNEL is a test of your mind, your sanity, your very will to survive in a hostile and forgotten world. Master the tools left by the previous mecano-printers to control and fix the elevator. Find pieces of the stories scattered across the environment using the Remote Explorer™ by NãoVivo Corp. and put light onto CHIONE's Team disappearance.

Maybe this expedition is pointless.

Or maybe it will lead a nomad like you to answers you waited all your life.

content_descriptors.notes: Vertigo, Thalassophia, no violence visible but presence of corpses or skeletons, sounds of wars and disasters

  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 2400G or Intel Core i7-7700K
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1070 or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 9 5900X or Intel Core i7-10700K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 3070 or AMD equivalent
